internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Returning/exchange links dialogue and return, while purity/whiteness links the two noun families; combining both is a two-core patch, not one root contribution.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: No candidate survived comparison without becoming a disjunction of lexical families.
internal_discovery.rationale: Complete coverage exposes four disconnected families; semantic unity is not forced.
